policy.numeric_matching: Absolute difference <= 0.00005 for values printed to four decimal places; no best-convention selection
policy.qualitative_comparison: Use primary convention, report every group and effect difference; ties within 1e-12. No invented significance or equivalence threshold.
policy.configuration_separation: Do not combine protocols, physical losses, validation designs, source inventories, hyperparameters, implementations or numerical environments
policy.source_data: Published workbook values are references, never independently reproduced training
policy.claim_scope: Passing training/checkpoint reload is code success; independent scientific claims require the rule-specific evidence

claim_rules.decision_rule: Audit four sources and count batteries/samples under explicit row/cycle/pair definitions. Report count agreement only; no diversity inference from file count alone.
All55 XJTU trajectories must map to six documented groups. Replot capacities; label periodically measured/interpolated capacity.

Separate successful training on provided features from independently extracted feature agreement. Raw I/V/time are required for the latter; kurtosis convention conflict remains unresolved until checked.
Compute11x16 Pearson coefficients and show chemistry/protocol group comparisons. Similarity is exploratory support only; causal chemistry interpretation is unavailable without controls.

For11 complete regular groups compare PINN to both baselines for MAE/MAPE/RMSE. Report each win/tie/loss and total; 'most' means strictly more than half of the33 group-metric cells. No universal claim.
Compare repeat SD for all33 regular group-metric cells, separately ddof0/ddof1. Report win/tie/loss; smaller mean error alone does not establish stability.
Match architecture and parameter counts exactly; CPU timing is descriptive unless hardware/software match. Report measured setup and ratio, not an exact timing claim on different cloud CPU.
For all28 small-sample group/n cells compare three models on MAPE/RMSE. A best-in-all statement requires no loss; otherwise report the supported subset and counterexamples.

For each group/model report n1->n4 error change and each adjacent change. General improvement uses negative endpoint difference in more than half of compared settings; strict monotonicity requires every adjacent difference <=0.
Report RMSE(PINN n1)-RMSE(MLP/CNN n3/n4) for XJTU1/HUST. Nonpositive is an empirical outperform/tie; positive cannot be declared equivalent because paper specifies no equivalence margin.
Require6 batches x4 sizes x3 models x10 independent repeats, with batch1 overlap counted once, and all exact test IDs checked.

For each of12 directions pair each fine-tune with its own source-only target predictions. Require fixed-G identical hashes and F update; report RMSE change and repeats improved. Support for all directions requires all12 mean differences <0.

For12 directions compare fine-tune RMSE to matched target-only n1. Require identical target tests, training battery, seed convention, validation and numerical protocol; otherwise label unmatched and do not infer improvement.
For directions targeting XJTU1/TJU3 compare fine-tune RMSE to matched target-only n2 and list every direction. Report direction-specific outcomes; broad all-target wording is not assumed.
Report chemistry-class effects for the complete transfer matrix with target difficulty and source error. Exploratory associations cannot establish chemistry as the cause or guarantee transfer.
Report dataset-equal, batch-equal, battery-equal and sample-pooled PINN MAPE. Label0.87% headline reproduced only under an explicitly stated aggregation; original overall weighting is unspecified.

Audit actual formulas and parameter gradients. Distinguish current author loss, publication label-only loss (zero model gradient), and prediction monotonicity; each is a separate protocol. No loss-importance conclusion without added labeled ablation.
Require unchanged-G hashes, changed-F proof and improved transfer versus source-only. This supports usefulness of reused dynamics only; electrochemical identifiability remains unavailable.

Audit test identities, disjoint batteries, normalization fit scope and checkpoint selection. Report demonstrated controls and remaining unknowns; design rationale alone cannot prove absence of all leakage.
Source audit can verify first derivatives are used. No accuracy/complexity superiority without derivative-order comparison; publication reports no such ablation.

Summarize supported regular/small/transfer results. Faster learning requires matched convergence/work/time evidence; BMS usefulness requires deployment testing. Scheduler throughput is not model-learning evidence.
